findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:59 says a 30-second status wait never changes state, but packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1220 calls reconcileManagedHostRun on every poll and that reconciler can write timed_out or cancelled terminal state at lines 1181-1199. The observation timeout itself is non-terminal, but the status command is also the documented next-touch reconciler; severity=medium.

doc-code-drift: docs/host-run-usage.md:285-290 says both caps always run and every refusal writes a blocked ledger row, while packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1302-1367 explicitly disables budget enforcement and all ledger rows when LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0, retaining only provider admission. The same document states the correct ledger-off behavior at lines 325-330 and 354-355, so the caps section is internally contradictory; severity=medium.

doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/session-ownership-and-write-leases.md:272-274 says normal lattice-review-* gate reviewers must be able to call review_pass_set and finding_add, but packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:129-135 expressly forbids those calls for managed cross-provider reviewers, and packages/main/src/core/native-review-evidence.ts:165-170 requires a registered broker attestation for native direct evidence. The section labels itself the current active contract yet omits both current authority paths; severity=medium.

doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/tier-c-crosshost-quorum-execution-plan.md:69-75 says cross_host_review records only stdoutDigest provenance through the old direct capture flow, but packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:648-679 now submits or resumes one ManagedHostRun, lines 724-732 return its receipt, and lines 1047-1060 persist receiptId plus managedRunId provenance. The historical M1 paragraph needs an explicit supersession/current-state note so it does not teach the retired provenance contract; severity=medium.
